other_failure_modes.name: Test data leakage via global aggregation
other_failure_modes.description: The agent concatenates the train and test sets to compute group-level aggregate statistics (e.g., means) and maps them back as features. This leaks the statistical distribution of the test set into the training data, invalidating the integrity of the validation and likely causing overfitting to the test set.

summary: The agent implements a solid feature engineering pipeline and successfully fits multiple gradient boosting models on both the log and raw target scales. However, the solution suffers from two critical flaws: using a randomized K-Fold split that ignores the temporal nature of the bike-sharing dataset (FM05), and leaking test set statistics into the training features by aggregating over the concatenated train and test data. Additionally, it uses naive ensembling (FM12) and skips basic data cleaning (FM03).
